epic_text:
Epic: Search Autocomplete
As a user, I want search suggestions as I type so that I can find products faster.

AC1: Suggestions appear after 2 characters typed
AC2: Max 10 suggestions displayed
AC3: Suggestions ranked by popularity (last 30 days)
AC4: Recent searches shown when input is empty
AC5: Keyboard navigation (arrow keys + enter)
AC6: Debounce: 300ms delay before API call
prd_text: Search autocomplete for e-commerce product catalog. Must handle 50k+ products. Suggestions ranked by purchase frequency. Cache popular queries in Redis.
architecture_text: Frontend: React with debounced input. Backend: FastAPI endpoint. Elasticsearch for full-text search with completion suggester. Redis cache for top 1000 queries.
